svg.title: Reconciliation: matching our ledger to the processor settlement file by attempt id
svg.desc: Six rows. att_101 and att_102 match on amount and status. att_103 is processing on our side and captured in the file, so it is auto-resolved to succeeded. att_104 is in our ledger but missing from the file, att_105 is in the file but missing from our ledger, and att_106 differs in amount, 30.00 against 3.00; these three are breaks for a person to investigate.
svg.text: nightly match, joined on attempt id
